set.tovw: Lead grade C (treasure thread): two accounts, more said to remain
set.n: Pensioner's hoard, small house on Mill Street, Fergus Falls
set.pl: Mill Street, downtown Fergus Falls (N-S from Lake Alice to Alcott Ave on the 1903 Sanborn); house number unknown
pinev: Street-level: 1903 Sanborn shows Mill St running N-S downtown from Lake Alice to Alcott Ave; house number unknown, so the circle covers the whole street (about 900 m).
set.st: A one-armed Civil War pensioner who lived for years in a small house on Mill Street died in Sept 1903. Neighbours found about $2,400 hidden in a trunk, a book cover and pocketbooks, but his heirs said pension receipts showed about $15,000 received and almost nothing spent, so $8,000-10,000 was still hidden about the premises or unaccounted for. Urban lots: look-only. House number unknown: the circle covers the whole street, not the spot itself.
set.t: Built-over town lots on Mill Street: look-only unless an owner gives permission.
